purpose: Prepare the linked POSIX shell, numeric version and GitHub release tutorials in six languages; support separate approved batches and preserve comparison/code text in search.

review.method: AI source/target comparison of complete prose, metadata, tables and diagrams, followed by target-language reading
review.execution: Existing English/Korean source shell scripts were executed with local fixtures in this task; translated commands and JSON examples remain byte-identical to those sources.

implementation.approval: Explicit registered manifest selection and its exact hash; approval for one batch cannot authorize another.
implementation.diagrams: Preserve step order, branch presence and error/completion outcome; verify localized SVG labels and arrow counts. Labels still require semantic review.
implementation.tables: Translate descriptive cells while preserving structure, protected inline code and numeric/boolean cells.
implementation.search: Protect fenced and inline code before removing real HTML, preserving numeric comparisons and generic types.

browser.telemetryIsolation: isolatedContext before page creation; service workers blocked

limits: AI self-review is not independent human or native-speaker sign-off.
New translations remain unpublished; neither parent PR nor this work records a publication approval.
Static output and search-content preservation do not measure search-engine indexing or traffic.
